title: SportsPro: Post-Market Clinical Follow Up Study
official: A Retrospective, Multi-Center, Post-Market Clinical Follow-Up Study of Stryker Class IIb Implants
summary: Retrospective, multi-center, chart review (only to include data that is part of the surgeons' standard practice)
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Subject was ≥ 18 years of age at the time of the surgery
2. Subject has undergone joint space repair using one of the study devices

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Subjects who are less than 6 months post-intervention
2. Concurrent participation in an investigational clinical study during the study period
